svg.title: Illustrative Earth-system tipping cascade, formal v2
svg.desc: White-background scientific synthesis with a three-state scenario rail, a central numbered world-system network, five outer feedback arcs, twelve layered coupling routes, external node and edge keys, and a recovery-lag inset.
svg.text: Illustrative coordinates only — not assessed thresholds or forecasts
numbered anchors carry geography · outer arcs carry system-wide feedback · E1–E12 carry directed coupling
EDGE KEY · directed influence on cascade tendency
Conceptual synthesis; signs and strengths vary by state, model and forcing pathway.
